notes.title: Zap Blastum: Galactic Tactics Demo!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34057612/0bf2d23ef50f25acd406b357bd03ec4901458c50.gif[/img]


For one week, play a brand-new demo of Zap Blastum in the Steam Game Festival! Play as an adorable alien in this twin-stick cover shooter with lock-on targeting! Robots have invaded your planet, and they don't even see you as a threat. Beat the odds and SAVE THE GALAXY! 

Try the first few levels and a small handful of weapons, items, and upgrades.

notes.title: Zap Blastum: Galactic Tactics Q&A Stream
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34057612/4aaf3b1ccce921fdf585d6d6b83fa55466679886.gif[/img]


[b]Friday 6/19[/b] 
[b]1 PM PDT (4 PM EDT)[/b]


Join us for a live Q&A session and play-through of the full game on Expert difficulty. No way we'll complete it, but you'll see some of what the demo is missing!

Zap Blastum is a twin-stick cover shooter with lock-on targeting, and you play as an adorable alien who just wants to SAVE THE GALAXY!
